briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push frontier capabilities amid escalating race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases with enhanced reasoning and agentic systems. Global compute investments surge as regulatory scrutiny intensifies around safety. Competition remains fierce across US and China labs.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with advanced multi-step reasoning while Anthropic releases Claude 4.5. Google DeepMind deploys Gemini 3 and Meta open-sources Llama 4. xAI and DeepSeek expand agent capabilities.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, IoT and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates with TSMC capacity deals. Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100 equivalent clusters. Saudi Arabia commits $8B to AI data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first ASI system emerge from a US lab or a multinational consortium by 2029?
